case_name: Km. Priyanshi (Minor) vs Kurmanchal Nagar Sehkari Bank Limited

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Km. Priyanshi (Minor), daughter of Mr. Kranti Kumar
parties.respondent_defendant: Kurmanchal Nagar Sehkari Bank Limited and another

facts_of_case: Petitioner is a minor whose biological father is Mr. Kranti Kumar. The guardian of the petitioner, Dolly Aray, had a divorce decree in her favor with permanent alimony awarded to her. She then married again and adopted the petitioner. The bank has not updated the name of the father in an FDR.

legal_principles.principle: A registered adoption deed can change the parentage in a FDR.
legal_principles.held: Looking to the apparent registered adoption deed, which was registered on 06.04.2016 and was also duly endorsed by the biological father Mr. Kranti Kumar, in fact, it could be the logically inferred that Kranti Kumar, the biological father, very candidly has accepted, the factum of second marriage, the factum of the adoption of the petitioner by Mr. Harish Tiwari and as such, the change in name of the parentage in the FDR, was a
cited_cases: Km. Priyanshi (Minor) vs Kurmanchal Nagar Sehkari Bank Limited on 3 May, 2021

legal_principles.principle: A change in name of the parentage in a FDR requires acceptance by the biological father.

cited_cases: Km. Priyanshi (Minor) vs Kurmanchal Nagar Sehkari Bank Limited on 3 May, 2021

outcome.final_order: The court directed the bank to update the name of the father in the FDR from Mr. Kranti Kumar to Mr. Harish Tiwari, the adopted father.
